snapshot.reason: Peiport Holdings is subject to a possible unconditional mandatory cash offer, which typically provides a premium to the current market price for shareholders.
snapshot.why_now: The joint announcement of the sale and purchase agreement and the possible cash offer was made today, November 9, 2026.
source_headlines: PEIPORT HOLD (02885): JOINT ANNOUNCEMENT - (1) SALE AND PURCHASE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE OFFEROR AND THE VENDOR; (2) POSSIBLE UNCONDITIONAL MANDATORY CASH OFFER BY SHENWAN HONGYUAN CAPITAL (H.K.) LIMITED FOR AND ON BEHALF OF THE OFFEROR TO ACQUIRE ALL THE ISSUED SHARES OF THE COMPANY (OTHER THAN THOSE ALREADY OWNED AND/OR AGREED TO BE ACQUIRED BY THE OFFEROR, ITS BENEFICIAL OWNERS AND PARTIES ACTING IN CONCERT WITH ANY OF THEM); (3) APPOINTMENT OF INDEPENDENT FINANCIAL ADVISER;
